newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BIDVEST BUYS SENTRACHEM YEAST UNIT.
newsitem.headline: BIDVEST BUYS SENTRACHEM YEAST UNIT.

text.p: Bidvest Group Ltd has acquried Sentrachem Ltd's NCP Yeast business, the companies said in a joint statement on Monday.
Sentrachem will receive over 40 million rand in cash from the deal, which excludes NCP's shareholding in Yeastpro which will be subject to a second transaction.
The disposal is in line with Sentrachem's recent announcement of its intention to sell certain secondary businesses.

NCP Yeast, the second largest player in the domestic yeast market, will be incorporated into Bidvest's Combined Foods division, which specialises in the manufacture and distribution of food ingredients.
